name: inter.js
description: TypeScript SDK for the Banco Inter partner APIs: Cobrança (Boleto com Pix), Banking, Pix and Pix Automático. mTLS, OAuth scopes, retries, rate limiting and typed webhooks included.

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:esm && bun run build:cjs && bun run build:types
scripts.build:esm: bun build src/index.ts src/webhooks/index.ts src/utils/index.ts src/testing.ts --outdir dist --root src --target node --format esm --splitting --sourcemap=linked
scripts.build:cjs: bun build src/index.ts src/webhooks/index.ts src/utils/index.ts src/testing.ts --outdir dist/cjs --root src --target node --format cjs --sourcemap=linked && printf '{"type":"commonjs"}\n' > dist/cjs/package.json
scripts.build:types: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && bun run scripts/fix-dts.ts dist
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
